schematic.trace.inj.step.3: ECU E1 pin B 20 — injector driver
schematic.trace.inj.step.5: Grounding point BA via ECU B 16
schematic.trace.ign.label: Ignition coil 1

schematic.trace.ign.step.3: ECU E1 pin B 102 — coil supply
schematic.trace.ign.step.5: ECU E1 pin B 57 — IGT signal

schematic.task.0.prompt: Locate fuse EFI 1 on the power distribution rail.
schematic.task.0.explain: Fuse EFI 1 pin 2 feeds ECU E1 pins A 2 and A 3 on black wires.
schematic.task.1.prompt: Select the ignition coil relay R16.
schematic.task.1.explain: R16 pin 2 is bonded to ECU pin A 50 on a white/black wire that becomes brown at the ECU.
schematic.task.2.prompt: Identify the grounding point bonded to ECU pin B 16.
schematic.task.2.explain: Grounding point BA pin 1 takes ECU pins B 16, B 51 and B 59.
schematic.task.3.prompt: Locate the mass airflow meter with air temperature sensor.
schematic.task.3.explain: L3 uses five ECU pins: A 2 / A 3 earth, B 90, B 91, B 92 and B 122.
schematic.task.4.prompt: Select the component driven by ECU pin B 20.
schematic.task.4.explain: ECU pin B 20 drives Injector 1 pin 2 on a black wire.
schematic.task.5.prompt: Locate CAN system 1 on the network rail.
schematic.task.5.explain: CAN system 1 H is on ECU A 13 (black), L is on ECU A 26 (white).
schematic.task.6.prompt: Select the accelerator pedal position sensor.
schematic.task.6.explain: G1 uses six ECU pins, A 51 to A 56 — two supplies, two earths, two signals.
schematic.task.7.explain: Main relay pin 1 is controlled from ECU A 46 (blue); pin 2 grounds via A 50.
schematic.exam.0.prompt: Identify the component at the highlighted position.
